label: CarlitoxxPro CPGOS03-0490 v2 GPON SFP ONT
description: mini-GPON ONT in an SFP module (Realtek RTL9601CI, 64 MB RAM / 8 MB flash, Linux (Luna SDK)) that presents to the host as 2.5G Ethernet; GPON line rate 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up on sc-apc with no LAN ports and no Wi-Fi, managed over web UI + telnet.
